# 1EYE — Open Source Lab
> 1EYE is an open-source lab. Its first project, Telepathic Data Transfer, is a free, open-source app (MIT) to send files, chat and links between your phone and PC over Wi-Fi or from anywhere. Works like AirDrop for Windows, Android, macOS and Linux; iPhone uses Safari. No account, no cloud, PIN-protected.

- [Download](https://1eye.dpdns.org/data-transfer/#download): Windows .exe, Android .apk, macOS and Linux binaries
- [Guides](https://1eye.dpdns.org/guides/): AirDrop for Windows, Android to PC without USB, iPhone to Windows, large files, remote access, offline transfer
- [Privacy](https://1eye.dpdns.org/privacy.html) · [Terms](https://1eye.dpdns.org/terms.html)
- [Source code](https://github.com/balajsajjad7-bot/1eye)
